adjudication.rationale: Looking at app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, the job has `sidekiq_options retry: false` (line 12) and the `poll_feed` method iterates through `rss.items.each` (line 31-36). If any item processing fails (e.g., malformed content, invalid URL, encoding issues), the exception will propagate and abort the entire loop since there's no error handling around individual items. With retries disabled, this means all subsequent items won't be processed until the next hourly poll. This is a real bug - a single bad feed item can block processing of all remaining items.
